{{Refimprove|date=September 2016}}{{Infobox place demographics|place=[[Samoa]]|image=File:Samoa single age population pyramid 2020.png|image_size=350|caption=Population pyramid of Samoa in 2020|size_of_population=206,179 (2022 est.)|nation=Samoan|official=Samoan, English|age_0–14_years=29.31%|age_65_years=6.18%|growth=0.63% (2022 est.)|birth=19.21 births/1,000 population (2022 est.)|death=5.37 deaths/1,000 population (2022 est.)|net_migration=-7.51 migrant(s)/1,000 population (2022 est.)|infant_mortality=18 deaths/1,000 live births|life=75.19 years|life_male=72.28 years|life_female=78.25 years|fertility=2.42 children born/woman (2022 est.)}}

[[Demography|Demographic]] features of the [[Population (human biology)|population]] of [[Samoa]] include [[population density]], [[Ethnic group|ethnicity]], education level, health of the populace, economic status, religious affiliations and other aspects of the population.

==Population==
